summary: the row of gpt_write_refusal.sh, the recovery shell's `disk write` at GPT and MBR disks, on i686, with recovery kernels built from a private copy of rach2/

argv: rm -rf ${WORK}/tree && mkdir -p ${WORK}/tree/build/tools/inspect && cp -R rach2 mk ${WORK}/tree/ && cp ${SRC}/rach2/kernel.c ${WORK}/tree/rach2/kernel.c && make -s test-image build/tests/system/harness build/tools/image/mkgpt build/tools/inspect/elfcheck ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp build/tools/inspect/elfcheck ${WORK}/tree/build/tools/inspect/elfcheck && printf 'build/tools/inspect/elfcheck: ;\n' >${WORK}/tree/Makefile && make -s -j8 -C ${WORK}/tree/rach2 COMPONENT=rach2-recovery KEXTRA=-DRACH2_RECOVERY ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp ${WORK}/tree/build/rach2-recovery/kernel ${WORK}/kernel
mkdir -p ${WORK}/${PHASE} && exec sh tests/system/gpt_write_refusal.sh ${WORK}/kernel build/images/test.krffs build/tests/system/harness build/tools/image/mkgpt ${WORK}/${PHASE}/row

faults.name: refusal-removed
faults.summary: the refusal of a disk with a GPT header taken out, so that the command writes the backup header

lines: gpt-write: FAIL: a GPT disk with no protective MBR: the disk write changed the disk
gpt-write: FAIL: a GPT disk with no protective MBR: the recovery shell's disk write was not refused

faults.name: backup-unread
faults.summary: the read of the last sector taken out, so that a disk whose LBA 1 says nothing is taken for one without a table

lines: gpt-write: FAIL: a GPT disk with no protective MBR whose primary header is gone: the disk write changed the disk
gpt-write: FAIL: a GPT disk with no protective MBR whose primary header is gone: the recovery shell's disk write was not refused

faults.name: mbr-unread
faults.summary: the check of the MBR's entries taken out, so that a partition reaching the last sector is not seen

lines: gpt-write: FAIL: an MBR disk whose partition reaches the last sector: the disk write changed the disk
gpt-write: FAIL: an MBR disk whose partition reaches the last sector: the recovery shell's disk write was not refused
